prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. Three female friends aged 28, 33 and 41 pause at their first pottery class to admire a freshly made slightly crooked clay bowl held carefully by one of them. Give them distinct appearances: short dark hair and glasses, long auburn waves, and short sandy-blonde hair. Clay marks on ordinary aprons and fingertips feel real. Use soft studio daylight, believable bowl weight and separate hands. Refined warm lifestyle editorial photography with considered light and relaxed expressions. Square 1:1 gallery composition, with comfortable room around faces, hands and the complete action. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.
Native image aspect ratio exactly 1:1. One woman supports the clay bowl's base with one palm and steadies its outside with the other hand, with individual visible fingers and natural moist clay smudges. The other friends keep their hands separate from hers.
review: Square pottery-class scene shows three distinct women admiring one slightly uneven clay bowl. The central woman supports its base with one palm and steadies the outside with separate clay-marked fingers; no hands merge with the bowl or each other. Faces, aprons, clay texture and continuous tabletop are natural, with full heads and complete bowl action framed and no text or logos.
